case.summary: The investigation was triggered by an unusual product code never used before and a new device ID. Step-up authentication was assumed to result in no reply from the customer within 24 hours. The verdict is uncertain with a fraud probability of 0.464 due to missing decisive evidence. Consequently, Fraud Policy R4 actions of monitoring the card and declining pending authorizations were followed because of the lack of a customer reply within 24 hours.
